accounts_lifecycle_timestamps_consistent.name: accounts_lifecycle_timestamps_consistent
accounts_lifecycle_timestamps_consistent.value:
(
        ("accounts"."lifecycle_state" = 'invited' AND "accounts"."contact_verified_at" IS NULL AND "accounts"."activated_at" IS NULL AND "accounts"."suspended_at" IS NULL AND "accounts"."closed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("accounts"."lifecycle_state" = 'pending_onboarding' AND "accounts"."contact_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."activated_at" IS NULL AND "accounts"."suspended_at" IS NULL AND "accounts"."closed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("accounts"."lifecycle_state" = 'active' AND "accounts"."contact_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."suspended_at" IS NULL AND "accounts"."closed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("accounts"."lifecycle_state" = 'suspended' AND "accounts"."contact_verified_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."suspended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."closed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("accounts"."lifecycle_state" = 'closed' AND "accounts"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("accounts"."lifecycle_state" = 'anonymization-pending' AND "accounts"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

conflict_disclosures_exactly_one_subject.name: conflict_disclosures_exactly_one_subject
conflict_disclosures_exactly_one_subject.value:
(
        ("conflict_disclosures"."claim_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conflict_disclosures"."evidence_submission_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("conflict_disclosures"."claim_id" IS NULL AND "conflict_disclosures"."evidence_submission_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

conversation_pseudonyms_rotation_pair.name: conversation_pseudonyms_rotation_pair
conversation_pseudonyms_rotation_pair.value:
(
        ("conversation_pseudonyms"."rotated_at" IS NULL AND "conversation_pseudonyms"."superseded_by_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("conversation_pseudonyms"."rotated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_pseudonyms"."superseded_by_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

conversation_pseudonyms_not_rotated_and_.name: conversation_pseudonyms_not_rotated_and_deleted
conversation_pseudonyms_not_rotated_and_.value: NOT ("conversation_pseudonyms"."rotated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_pseudonyms"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)

document_versions_counsel_reviewed_needs.name: document_versions_counsel_reviewed_needs_provenance
document_versions_counsel_reviewed_needs.value: ("document_versions"."state" <> 'counsel_reviewed' AND "document_versions"."state" <> 'published' AND "document_versions"."state" <> 'superseded') OR ("document_versions"."counsel_reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

invitations_accepted_requires_account_an.name: invitations_accepted_requires_account_and_timestamp
invitations_accepted_requires_account_an.value:
(
        ("invitations"."status" <> 'accepted')
        OR (
          "invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "invitations"."accepted_account_id" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

invitations_pending_has_no_acceptance.name: invitations_pending_has_no_acceptance
invitations_pending_has_no_acceptance.value:
(
        ("invitations"."status" <> 'pending')
        OR (
          "invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL
          AND "invitations"."accepted_account_id" IS NULL
        )
      )

topics_published_requires_provenance.name: topics_published_requires_provenance
topics_published_requires_provenance.value: ("topics"."publication_status" <> 'published') OR ("topics"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "topics"."published_by_account_id" IS NOT NULL)

topics_unpublished_clears_publication_st.name: topics_unpublished_clears_publication_stamp
topics_unpublished_clears_publication_st.value: ("topics"."publication_status" <> 'unpublished') OR ("topics"."published_at" IS NULL AND "topics"."published_by_account_id" IS NULL)

verification_cases_terminal_needs_reason.name: verification_cases_terminal_needs_reason
verification_cases_terminal_needs_reason.value: ("verification_cases"."status" IN ('pending', 'appealed')) OR ("verification_cases"."decision_reason" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("verification_cases"."decision_reason")) > 0)
